'''Jacobus Verbaarschot''' is an American [[physicist]]. He is a [[distinguished professor]] in the department of [[physics]] and [[astronomy]] at [[Stony Brook University]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://tonic.physics.sunysb.edu/~verbaarschot/|title=Jacobus Verbaarschot|work=[[Stony Brook University]]|access-date=May 25, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.stonybrook.edu/commcms/faculty-pathways/_archive-fp/awards/distinguished.php|title=Distinguished Professorships|work=[[Stony Brook University]]|access-date=May 25, 2026}}</ref>

In 2011, Verbaarschot was named a [[List of fellows of the American Physical Society|fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]], "for the development of random-matrix theory methods and their applications in atomic nuclei and in nonperturbative quantum chromodynamics".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/winners?q=verbaar&af=false|title=APS Fellow Archive|work=[[American Physical Society]]|access-date=May 25, 2026}}</ref>
